entries.389d5284c801609d: A practical training service that helps participants acquire the mindset and skills needed by global talent.
entries.50edf7ff4b70fec0: A service in which overseas subsidiaries provide locally, to local corporations, a proprietary curriculum based on the classroom training offered by the Company. Participants include not only Japanese employees working at local corporations but also local employees. Net sales for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥140,963 thousand (down 23.6% from the same period of the previous year), and the securities report gives as the reason that the subsidiaries in China and Singapore were unable to win projects of the same scale as in the previous year. The main related companies are the subsidiaries in China and Singapore, and QUINTEGRAL PHILIPPINES, INC. However, that company was acquired in December 2025 and only its balance sheet was consolidated in this fiscal year, so it is not included in this fiscal year's net sales.
entries.622471d4d169955f: A service that provides hierarchical business skills training and mindset training, mainly for new and young employees, and also focuses on the managerial level. Based on the company's original curriculum, a dedicated customization team develops products to meet the needs of client companies, and training is conducted by certified instructors (many of whom are experienced external instructors) who have passed the certification process set by the company. Online training is the main focus, and group training, pre- and post-training follow-up, and e-learning are provided according to the status of participants. The main affiliated companies are the company and Quintegral Co., Ltd.
entries.6584e74d1a88a04f: The service category with the largest net sales among the 3 service categories, consisting of classroom training and global human resource development.
entries.6d777ba969a35260: A company that supports employee development through corporate training and e-learning.
entries.828c96550d354af7: The category with the largest revenue among the three service categories, consisting of classroom-style training and global human resource development. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥3,060,306 thousand (up 20.6% year on year). The securities report cites as reasons that delivery of new-employee introductory training in classroom-style training proceeded as usual, the receipt and delivery of large projects, and the effect of Energy Switch Co., Ltd. and Quintegral Co., Ltd. being included in consolidation.

entries.b4c6247b2ef44ed8: A service providing "etudes," a cloud-based e-learning system (LMS, learning management system).
entries.bbbfeaf04d2bd4a7: This is a service providing "etudes," a cloud-based e-learning system (LMS, learning management system). The company acquired the business in August 2019 and began operating it in September of that year. The annual securities report states that it can deliver a wide variety of teaching materials to PCs, smartphones and tablets, and can be used by anywhere from a few people to several hundred thousand. Net sales for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥436,573 thousand (up 18.9% from the same period of the previous year). The annual securities report gives as reasons that, although the number of client companies temporarily fell because of introductions at the lowest price, the decline bottomed out and stabilized, and sales per 1 user (ARPU) grew substantially because of higher average spending per customer. The main related company is the company itself.

entries.facb66990b0962c6: Government agencies, private companies, educational corporations and local governments in Japan and overseas (the securities report states that the customers are corporations and that contracts are made for each training program)
entries.fe94e66503349c75: A practical training service that helps participants acquire the mindset and skills needed by global talent. It includes training taken while staying at the sites of local partners (universities) that cooperate with the Group in various Asian countries, and online business English conversation for busy working adults. The securities report states that training is being moved online, and that participants can also take local partners' training while remaining in Japan. The main related companies are the Company and subsidiaries in China, Singapore, India and the Philippines.
entries.ff1158d4904cd77a: The Group's only reportable segment, a business that supports human resource development for companies and other organizations through training and e-learning. The securities report does not present segment information and instead presents net sales by service. Net sales for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥3,637,843 thousand (up 17.8% from the same period of the previous year), and operating profit was ¥354,035 thousand. The services are aimed at employees of government agencies, private companies, educational corporations and local governments in Japan and overseas; the customers are corporations, and contracts are made for each training program. There is no customer accounting for 10% or more of net sales.
